scripts.test: npm run build && echo PAYSTACK_SECRET_KEY=sk_test_emulator > .secret.local && firebase emulators:exec --project demo-firefight --only auth,firestore,functions 'node --test lib/test/*.test.js'
scripts.serve: npm run build && firebase emulators:start --project demo-firefight --only auth,firestore,functions
scripts.deploy: npm run build && firebase deploy --only functions,firestore
